phrase: arco ou besta acondicionadas em estojo ou bolsa
note: Of a weapon or arrows, stowed in a case or a quiver.

phrase: deve disparar sobre o animal, apontando
note: Also point: bico apontado para o solo is a bill pointed at the ground.
Also an arch.

phrase: não podem utilizar armas de caça
não pode utilizar arma de fogo
armas semiautomáticas que comportem mais de três munições

note: To make a bow or crossbow ready to shoot; of a crossbow, to cock it.

phrase: desde que se atire com o motor em movimento
note: Also throw: atirar a flecha is to throw the arrow.
Usually a bullet; from a shotgun, a single solid slug.
A backward hook on an arrowhead. On an animal, a dewlap.

phrase: O caçador só poderá utilizar besta
note: Not a beast: the crossbow.
The pellets in a cartridge; chumbo alone is lead. The large ones are zagalotes.
Shooting while swinging the bow to follow a moving animal.

phrase: Ter o arco ou besta pronto a disparar

note: A shot fired; chumbos is shot, the pellets.

phrase: sem levar o arco em tensão
note: Of a bow, drawn and ready to shoot.
Exercício here is practice, as in exercício da caça.
Elsewhere a barb or a splinter; the bank calls an arrowhead's barb barbela.

phrase: duas flechas ou virotões na mão
a largura mínima de corte das pontas
note: The width of the cut an arrowhead's blades make.
Of an arrow or bolt set on the bow, ready to shoot. Also a cork or holm-oak wood pasture.
Counted, a round: mais de três munições is more than three rounds.

phrase: as pontas das flechas ou virotões
note: The head of an arrow or a bolt; ponta alone is a tip.
A crossbow's draw weight, given in pounds.

phrase: cruzamento do animal com o projétil
Colocar as flechas ou virotões na aljava
note: A crossbow's arrow; flecha is the bow's.
A formal word for aiming at a mark; apontar is aim.
